rounds.text: Beryl Securities Ltd is experiencing a powerful acceleration in fundamentals, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 129% [E17] and a dramatic net profit surge of 207% year-on-year [E55]. This top-line and earnings velocity is backed by a multi-year profit uptrend [E58] and a strong 35% compounded profit growth over three years [E20]. Crucially, insiders are showing profound confidence as promoters have increased their stake by 8.18 percentage points from 52.41% to 60.59% [E35]. Furthermore, the business is operating against a supportive macro backdrop with the Financial Services sector displaying a strong tailwind score of +0.84 [E64], outperforming sector medians in ROCE at 7.84% versus the 6.2% benchmark [E10, E67]. Technical momentum confirms this positive fundamental shift, with the stock trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages alongside a healthy relative-strength rating of 75 [E42, E43]. Conceded: [E30], [E31], [E37], [E51], [E60].
